records.prompt:
Use case: production game environment, Starfall Lantern Landing. Create ONE bespoke tablet board background at 100% restored. Reference is the APPROVED phone version of this exact place. Preserve its premium soft 3D storybook rendering, rounded rosewood planks, brass star-shaped dock fittings, cream ceramic lantern with four hinged petal shutters OPEN around its glowing core, rope rails, lavender pennants, bench and luggage chest, lavender clouds and midnight blue universe. This is the SAME landmark and same magical arrival dock, a different camera composition revealing neighboring portions of the location, not a different theme. High floating 70-degree overhead camera, no horizon. Full continuous scenic painting edge to edge. Atmospheric cloud volume connects organically around the edges with no straight fade lines, rectangular cleared patches, framing panels, grids or artificial vignette. Native game will overlay actual star characters and HUD: do NOT draw characters, game pieces, text, UI, eyes or tiles. Midnight remains dark even at 100%; amber light warms only nearby architecture. The empty playable sky reads as real open space. Output opaque high quality PNG.
PORTRAIT TABLET composition, target aspect 3:4, canvas 1152x1536. Recompose the reference, do NOT stretch or pad it. The little main arrival deck sits at the TOP LEFT, occupying x=0..46% and y=0..21%. The large recognizable open lantern hangs near x=21%, y=8%; main deck must end by y=22%. Its curved gangway runs along the very TOP toward a small neighboring mooring platform at upper right; show a little rope pulley and a rolled sail there, extending the story of this same port. The top central x=30..75% y=7..20% is quiet sky for the HUD. The central x=6..94%, y=23..80% is quiet deep midnight-indigo open sky with subtle natural atmospheric depth, no buildings, no strong cloud banks, no bright pinpricks; it will hold the seven-column square puzzle. In the bottom corners below y=84%, an asymmetric near dock edge, coiled ropes and two mooring posts give depth and more of the landing to discover. Leave bottom center unobtrusive. Clouds surround outer top/bottom/side edges naturally; no hard rectangular edge and no center masking. The same proportions and simple readable large forms as the phone reference.
